about_short_description.short_description: Triplit is a database that helps app developers with realtime synchronization for web applications.

product.name: Triplit Database
product.description: An open-source database that synchronizes data in real-time between server and browser, supporting offline use and relational queries for web and mobile applications.

product.name: Triplit Client SDK
product.description: A TypeScript-based client library providing reactive queries, schema definitions, and synchronization capabilities for integrating Triplit Database into applications.

product.name: Triplit Server
product.description: A backend server component that manages data persistence, synchronization, and conflict resolution, deployable on Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, and other environments.

product.name: Triplit Console
product.description: A web-based database console for inspecting and managing data, schemas, roles, and permissions within Triplit Database instances.

product.name: Triplit Webhooks
product.description: A feature enabling Triplit Database to send event notifications (inserts, updates, deletes) to external APIs via configurable webhooks.
